func run(groups: [[Int]], pager: Pager, metrics: Metrics, uploads: Uploads) async throws {
  for batch in groups {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await read(item) } }
      for try await row in pager { consume(row) }
    }
  }
  for batch in groups {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await read(item) } }
      for try await row in tasks { consume(row) }
    }
  }
  for batch in groups {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await read(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      let page = try await pager.next()
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await tasks.waitForAll()
    }
  }
  for batch in groups {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await read(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      let total = try await tasks.reduce(0, +)
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      _ = try await metrics.reduce(total)
    }
  }
  for batch in groups {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await read(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      try await uploads.waitForAll()
    }
  }
  for batch in groups {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    let rows = try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { tasks in
      for item in batch { tasks.addTask { try await read(item) } }
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
      let first = try await tasks.next()
      return first
    }
    consume(rows)
  }
}
